injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of muscle or tendon of the rotator cuff of shoulder

manifestations.description: numbness in left shoulder and left hand

treatments_received.treatment: attendance at A&E of Prince of Wales Hospital; injection; discharge
source: She attended the A&E of Prince of Wales Hospital (“PWH”) after work but had to wait the whole night until the next day for consultation.
She was diagnosed as having a sprain and was given an injection and was discharged.
Since then, the plaintiff had attended various clinics and underwent physiotherapy.

Since then, the plaintiff has undergone many occupational therapy and physiotherapy sessions but she still had residue symptoms and disabilities like intermittent pain in left shoulder, numbness in left shoulder and left hand etc.
A MRI performed on 30 October 2014 showed “small full thickness tear involving the mid and posterior fibres of the supraspinatus tendon” and “tendinosis of the anterior part of the tendon”.
A further MRI was performed on 21 August 2015 which showed, amongst others, full thickness tear of the supraspinatus tendon with moderate muscle atrophy and suspected superior labral tear.

treatments_received.treatment: left shoulder arthroscopic cuff repair, superior labral repair and arthroscopic acromioplasty (22 March 2016)
source: The plaintiff underwent a left shoulder arthroscopic cuff repair, superior labral repair and arthroscopic acromioplasty on 22 March 2016.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Tendon repair / Suture of tendon not involving hand

losses.description: residue symptoms and disabilities like intermittent pain in left shoulder, numbness in left shoulder and left hand, weaknesses and stiffness

comparable_cases.case_name: Lam Hing Choi v Yip King On and others
comparable_cases.injury_description: This case again did not involve any remedial surgery, but there was a finding of muscle wasting in the shoulder so one might conclude that the residual symptoms were more severe.
